stories.title: Ethereum and Solana move trillions in volume, but face a native-token demand risk
stories.summary: Ethereum and Solana together settle trillions of dollars in stablecoin and tokenized-asset volume, according to CryptoSlate. The report argues this activity does not automatically translate into demand for ETH or SOL, since users mostly hold and move dollar-pegged tokens rather than the native assets. It frames this gap as a structural risk to the two chains' token economics.
stories.whyItMatters: If usage keeps decoupling from native-token demand, the investment case for holding ETH and SOL could weaken even as network activity grows.
whatToWatch: Any protocol changes tied to fee burns or staking meant to capture value from stablecoin activity.
Whether other analysts echo or dispute this framing.
questions: How would this trend affect ETH and SOL valuations over time?
Do Ethereum or Solana have a plan to address this gap?

sources.title: Ethereum and Solana are hosting trillions in dollar volume, yet their native tokens risk losing direct consumer demand

stories.title: The Sandbox pledges 1:1 repayment after $700K bridge exploit
stories.summary: The Sandbox, a blockchain-based metaverse platform, lost roughly $700,000 in a bridge exploit, according to Cointelegraph. The project has pledged to repay affected users on a 1:1 basis. The report did not detail how the exploit occurred.
stories.whyItMatters: Bridge exploits remain a common weak point in crypto infrastructure, and a fast, full repayment commitment matters for user trust.
whatToWatch: Confirmation of the repayment timeline.
Any post-mortem explaining how the bridge was breached.
questions: What vulnerability let the exploit happen?
Will the bridge be patched, audited, or replaced?

sources.title: The Sandbox pledges 1:1 repayment after $700K bridge exploit

stories.title: HashKey Cloud backs Stacks' Genesis Bond to test institutional demand for Bitcoin yield
stories.summary: HashKey Cloud has backed the Genesis Bond, a product from the Stacks network, according to CryptoSlate. The move is described as a test of institutional appetite for yield generated natively from Bitcoin. The report gave few details on the bond's structure or size.
stories.whyItMatters: Institutional interest in Bitcoin-native yield products would mark a shift from simple custody toward putting BTC to active use.
whatToWatch: Disclosed terms or size of the Genesis Bond.
Whether other institutional players follow HashKey Cloud's move.
questions: What yield does the bond target, and what are the risks?
Is HashKey Cloud investing directly or enabling client access?

sources.title: HashKey Cloud backs Stacks’ Genesis Bond to prove institutional appetite for native Bitcoin yield

stories.title: Ethereum's plan to triple network speed risks breaking existing smart contracts
stories.summary: A proposed Ethereum upgrade aimed at roughly tripling network speed could unintentionally break large numbers of deployed smart contracts, according to CryptoSlate. The report does not name the specific proposal or give a timeline, but presents the compatibility risk as real.
stories.whyItMatters: Backward compatibility underpins trust in Ethereum; contracts breaking without warning could disrupt DeFi protocols and put user funds at risk.
whatToWatch: Formal proposal details and developer community response.
Guidance from Ethereum core developers on testing or mitigation.
questions: Which contract types or code patterns are most at risk?
Is this upgrade close to deployment or still an early proposal?

sources.title: Ethereum’s plan to triple network speed could silently break millions of existing smart contracts

stories.title: Charles Schwab adds Solana, Avalanche, and Chainlink to its crypto platform
stories.summary: Charles Schwab has added Solana, Avalanche, and Chainlink to its newer crypto trading platform, according to Cointelegraph. This broadens the digital assets available to Schwab's client base beyond its initial offerings.
stories.whyItMatters: A major traditional brokerage expanding its crypto lineup signals deeper mainstream access to tokens beyond Bitcoin and Ether.
whatToWatch: Whether Schwab adds more tokens to the platform.
Client trading volumes for the newly listed assets.
questions: What criteria did Schwab use to pick these three tokens?
Are there restrictions on which clients can trade them?

sources.title: Charles Schwab adda Solana, Avalanche and Chainlink to nascent crypto platform

stories.title: Bitcoin's rally lifts mining stocks past AI stocks
stories.summary: Bitcoin has rallied 23%, according to Cointelegraph, and the rebound has pushed previously depressed Bitcoin mining stocks to outperform AI stocks in recent gains. The report ties the miners' equity gains directly to the move in Bitcoin's price.
stories.whyItMatters: Miner stocks act as a leveraged proxy for Bitcoin sentiment, so their outperformance versus a hot sector like AI shows how fast capital can rotate back into crypto.
whatToWatch: Whether miners hold these gains if Bitcoin's rally cools.
Individual miner earnings and operating updates.
questions: How much of the rally reflects Bitcoin's price versus company-specific factors?
Is this a durable rotation or a short-term reaction?

sources.title: Bitcoin’s 23% rally sends beaten-down miners soaring past AI stocks

stories.title: $6.4 billion in Bitcoin options are set to expire
stories.summary: Roughly $6.4 billion in Bitcoin options contracts are due to expire, according to Decrypt. Large expiries like this can add short-term price volatility as market makers adjust their hedges.
stories.whyItMatters: Big options expiries are a recurring source of near-term volatility that traders and risk managers watch closely.
whatToWatch: Bitcoin's price action around the expiry.
Whether implied volatility resets afterward.
questions: What is the put/call positioning heading into expiry?
Does price gravitate toward a specific 'max pain' level?

sources.title: $6.4 Billion in Bitcoin Options Expire Tomorrow—Here's What It Means

stories.title: Mirae Asset outlines crypto, stablecoin, and tokenization plans for Digital X
stories.summary: Mirae Asset has laid out plans covering crypto, stablecoins, and tokenization under an initiative called Digital X, according to Cointelegraph. The report did not include specific product details.
stories.whyItMatters: Mirae Asset is a major Asian financial firm, and its move into stablecoins and tokenization points to continued institutional build-out of digital-asset infrastructure in the region.
whatToWatch: Formal product launches or regulatory filings tied to Digital X.
Which markets Mirae Asset targets first.
questions: Is Digital X a regulated entity, and where?
What is the expected launch timeline?

sources.title: Mirae Asset lays out crypto, stablecoin, tokenization plans for Digital X

stories.title: Bitcoin gains a quantum-computing escape route, but millions of BTC may stay exposed
stories.summary: A quantum-computing 'escape route' for Bitcoin has emerged, according to CryptoSlate, offering holders a path to protect coins from future quantum attacks. The report estimates around 7 million BTC could remain exposed, likely because migrating requires action many holders or wallets may not take.
stories.whyItMatters: Quantum computing is a long-term but serious risk to Bitcoin's cryptography, and how the ecosystem handles exposed coins will shape its long-term security.
whatToWatch: Adoption rate of the new quantum-resistant option.
Any coordinated push to migrate at-risk legacy addresses.
questions: What technical mechanism does the escape route use?
Whose coins make up the 7 million BTC still exposed?

sources.title: Bitcoin now has a quantum computing escape route, but 7 million BTC may still be exposed

stories.title: Abu Dhabi royal reportedly backs 49% stake in Trump-linked crypto bank venture
stories.summary: An Abu Dhabi royal has backed a 49% stake in a crypto banking venture linked to Trump, according to a Cointelegraph report citing the Wall Street Journal. Further details on the venture's structure or plans were not included in the supplied reporting.
stories.whyItMatters: Ties between Gulf capital, US political figures, and crypto banking ventures raise questions about foreign investment and potential conflicts of interest.
whatToWatch: Additional detail from the original WSJ reporting.
Any regulatory response to the ownership structure.
questions: Who is the Abu Dhabi royal involved, and what is the venture's name?
What US regulatory approvals would this venture need?

sources.title: Abu Dhabi royal backs 49% stake in Trump-linked crypto bank venture: WSJ

stories.title: Moving self-custody Bitcoin onto Wall Street just got 25 times easier, and $5 billion already has
stories.summary: A new development has made it roughly 25 times easier to move self-custodied Bitcoin directly onto Wall Street platforms, according to CryptoSlate, with about $5 billion in BTC moved this way already. The report does not specify the exact mechanism behind the change.
stories.whyItMatters: Easier links between self-custody and traditional finance rails could speed up institutional Bitcoin adoption, while also raising custody and counterparty questions.
whatToWatch: Which platforms or products are driving the $5 billion figure.
Whether inflows continue at this pace.
questions: What technical or regulatory change enabled this 25x improvement?
Does this shift custody risk for holders in ways they should understand?

sources.title: It just got 25 times easier to move self-custody Bitcoin directly onto Wall Street, and $5 billion already has

stories.title: MANTRA Chain is back online, but undisclosed code changes worry developers
stories.summary: MANTRA Chain has resumed operations after an outage, according to CryptoSlate, but developers have raised concerns over code changes made without disclosure. The report does not specify what the changes altered or why they went uncommunicated.
stories.whyItMatters: Undisclosed changes to a blockchain's codebase raise transparency concerns for validators, developers, and users who depend on the network's integrity.
whatToWatch: Whether the MANTRA team publishes details on the changes.
Developer and community response, including calls for an audit.
questions: What specifically changed in the code?
Why weren't the changes disclosed beforehand?

sources.title: MANTRA Chain is back online, but silent code changes spark developer concerns
